summary: Overall assessment: the guide is scientifically careful. I read all 24 reader units (reading guide; chapters 1-21; glossary; references) and the extracted texts of the three main papers plus supplements/peer review. Every equation I checked against the sources (Burak & Fiete 2012 Eqs. 7-9 and SI S7-S95; Ben-Shushan et al. 2022 Eqs. 1-35; Mainali et al. 2025 Eqs. 1-10 and STAR Methods) matches the guide, including units, symbol meanings, and the local/vs-global qualifications. The guide correctly distinguishes its own derivations from quoted results and explicitly flags source inconsistencies that it verified algebraically: printed main Eq. 2 missing the square on d bar g_i/d theta (confirmed vs SI S18 and the 2017 correction), SI S40 vs S41/projection factor-of-two for mutual excitation (direct projection D = theta/(4 tau) matches S41), SI S71 plus-sign vs cosh solution S73, and Mainali supplement S23 (missing sqrt2) and S25 (sign). No confirmed error in the guide's own derivations was found. Remaining limits: several background/hardware source bodies were not locally available (Cannon & Robinson 1987 and Major et al. 2004 time-constant claims; Pehle 2022, Scholze 2026, LeGallo 2023, Massoud 2011, Giulioni 2012, Ortner 2025, Wang 2026, Ilmberger 2025), and PDF equation extraction is scrambled in a few places (Burak & Fiete SI S85 block sign; Mainali supplement S18 print-vs-extraction), so a few guide-flagged source issues could not be pixel-reconfirmed. The hardware Part respects its stated 2026-10-30 snapshot and does not pretend to a current SOTA survey.

retained_strengths: Consistent mechanism -> mathematical derivation -> interpretation structure (sec:READING-MECHANISM-MATH) applied across Chapters 3-6.

Symbol discipline: D reserved for diffusion coefficient, d for spatial dimension, q/C for place-field threshold/covariance, explicitly justified at front matter (L0172-L0180) to avoid collision with the memory chapters' D and theta.

Poisson counts, CV, Fano factor, and conditional independence taught before the diffusion calculation; the key qualification that independent count draws do not make recurrent spike trains independent (ch:FOUNDATIONS L0274).

Correct reproduction of Burak & Fiete derivations: projection via left/right zero eigenvectors (SI S7-S15), symmetric diffusion formula matching SI S18, and the information-diffusion bound with Cauchy-Schwarz; equality condition and its linear-family counterexample correctly qualified.

Verified algebraic flags of source inconsistencies with appropriate caveats: printed Eq. 2 missing square (vs SI S18 / 2017 correction), SI S40 vs S41 factor-of-two for mutual excitation (direct projection D = theta/(4 tau) matches S41), SI S71 plus-sign vs cosh S73, Mainali supplement S23/S25.

Readout chapter: storage/readout decomposition, naive vs ideal coth formula, partial-access scaling, and the demonstrated failure of main Eq. 6 as a universal lower bound (concrete strict counterexample).
Place-field chapters separate exact Kac-Rice results from high-threshold approximations, include EC boundary terms and slice-dimension logic, and flag data-processing choices and selection bias.
Simulation chapters are honest about what was not done (no reruns, no code execution) and label code/data gaps (eye MATLAB revision and missing per-panel settings; place `sigma` vs ell conversion).
Hardware Part keeps connection weights, neuron state, and represented value separate; uses an explicit 2026-10-30 snapshot date and does not claim a current SOTA survey.
Synthesis chapter keeps the three papers' objects distinct and gives a correct joint position-covariance calculation, clearly labeled as guide-derived.
Glossary and references are internally consistent with chapter notation and contribution labels (Central/Supporting/Background/Guide-derived).
